channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: What the US and Iran agreed – and disagreed – on first day of talks
item.description: Leaders from Iran and the US have lauded progress on day one of Switzerland talks but disagree about crucial aspects.

item.title: Former PM says Israel smuggled Starlink internet systems into Iran
item.description: Former PM Naftali Bennett has admitted Israel smuggled Starlink internet systems into Iran.

item.title: Israeli fire kills two in Lebanon as Hezbollah slams truce ‘violation’
item.description: Lebanese armed group Hezbollah denounced the 'treacherous attack', saying it was a 'blatant' violation of the truce.

item.title: Iran’s President Pezeshkian lands in Pakistan after US deal
item.description: Pakistan hosts Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian after mediating the breakthrough US-Iran negotiations in Switzerland.

item.title: What Israeli and Lebanese officials are saying before Washington talks
item.description: Iran has made a ceasefire in Lebanon a key condition in its ongoing negotiations with the US.

item.title: Iran says technical talks with US in Switzerland conclude successfully
item.description: Iran's top negotiator Mohammad Ghalibaf also says an agreement reached with the US to release $12bn in frozen assets.

item.title: Iran war day 116: US eases Iran sanctions; Israel kills two in Lebanon
item.description: US eases oil sanctions for 60 days after Iran agrees to allow international nuclear inspections.

item.title: Drowning deaths soar in France as Europe buckles in peak of heatwave
item.description: Forty people have drowned in heatwave-related deaths in France since last Thursday, Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu says.

item.title: Iran says no new commitments on nuclear sites after Vance says inspectors to be invited back
item.description: Iran's foreign ministry says it made "no new commitments" on nuclear inspections after talks in Switzerland.

item.title: UN commission of inquiry says Israel committing genocide in Gaza by deliberately targeting children
item.description: Israel rejects the new report by the three-member expert panel, calling it a "libellous sham".
